sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven near-front man with swept dark brown side-parted hair, dark brows and serious closed mouth. Dark navy lapelled jacket with pale piping, grey shirt and dark blue bow tie. Full pale grey-beige painted backing, close bust and soft side light; retain hair, bow, expression and short broad fitted neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man looking and slightly tilting toward screen left with thick swept dark hair and heavy dark brows. Dark teal high-collared military coat with red piping, elaborate gold leaf collar embroidery, gold shoulder boards, gold buttons, two star decorations at viewer left and white/gold star at throat. Stern closed mouth, full pale grey-beige backing; preserve medals/collar, compact broad neck and original tilt.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man nearly front facing with short swept dark hair greying at temples, strong brows and serious closed mouth. Dark green-teal lapelled military coat with gold leaf embroidery/red edging, gold shoulder boards, white shirt/black tie and small red/gold decoration at viewer right. Full pale grey-beige painted backing; retain details/pose/light and short broad collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven near-front man with swept side-parted brown hair and strong brows, serious closed mouth. Dark green high-neck military tunic with gold leaf collar/gold shoulder boards/red piping, white-gold star at throat, several gold star medals and red ribbon bars on viewer right and ribbon strip cropped along lower edge. Full pale grey-beige backing; preserve decorations and broad short neck within fitted closed collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven near-front man slightly toward screen left with receding brushed-back brown hair, dark brows and closed restrained mouth. Dark teal high-collared uniform with gold leaf embroidery/red piping and gold/red shoulder boards, small central gold star and colored hanging medals at viewer right. Full pale grey-beige backing and soft light; preserve uniform and short broad collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front man slightly toward screen left with short dark side-parted hair greying at sides, dark brows and closed neutral mouth. No clearly resolved moustache or chin beard; do not invent facial hair from upper-lip shading. Dark green-teal lapelled uniform with gold leaf trim/red edging and gold/red shoulder boards, pale grey pointed shirt and dark tie. Full pale grey-beige backing; compact broad fitted neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older clean-shaven man slightly toward screen left with grey temple hair beneath an olive-green peaked cap, deep red band, small red star and shiny black visor. Heavy dark brows, stern closed mouth. Olive high-collared army coat with red/gold collar tabs and brown shoulder strap at viewer left. Full pale grey-beige backing, close bust and shaded light; retain hat and short broad closed collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Young clean-shaven man turned toward screen left with short dark hair beneath grey fur cap with brown crown and red star. Dark brows and slightly parted restrained mouth. Grey military overcoat with red-edged dark collar patches/silver marks, olive high inner collar with two pale buttons and brown strap at viewer left. Full pale grey-beige backing and close bust; preserve fur, expression and broad short neck.
